title: Every simulator boot goes through the lock and is recorded
why: After PR #1022 (lane sim-machine-lock, Nov 1 20:43 CST), two holes remain: some boots skip the lock, and sim-test boots go unrecorded.
note:
Nov 6 11:51 CST (coordinator audit, Explore sonnet; PR head reachable from origin/main): DONE, evidence #1178 on main.
(1) xcodebuild -destination naming a shut-down device, and the MCP launch tool, still boot outside the sim-test lock; route or refuse them. (2) sim-test boots are no longer checked by sim-boot-is-verified and write no sim-boots.jsonl line, so a sim-test killed with SIGKILL leaves an unrecorded simulator that the sweep keeps; sim-test records its boot. Red first for each. Other gaps: docs/debts/notes.md (lane sim-machine-lock). Port: yes. Ready after PR #1022 merges. Lane [ended:lane:-sim-lock-holes], started by the coordinator Nov 3 16:57 CST. Landed Nov 5 in batch 10 (59bff081): #1178 refuses a simulator MCP launch that boots without a lease. Open: #1145.
